title: Characteristic ideal equals the voltage Laplacian determinant for connected leafless Zp-to-the-l graph covers with l at least two
author: Kleine, Sören; Müller, Katharina
work: On the growth of the Jacobians in $\mathbb{Z}_p^l$-voltage covers of graphs
difficulty_reason: The author constructs the Jacobian Iwasawa module from an inverse limit of finite covering divisor sequences, identifies the voltage Laplacian presentation, and compares it with the augmentation module through a rank-one pseudo-null cokernel. The completed-module and inverse-limit identifications are substantive core; rank at least two is essential and the rank-one correction is excluded.
source_scope_note: The selected problem is original Theorem5.3 with l>=2, the exact Jacobian characteristic-ideal/voltage-Laplacian determinant equality for the connected leafless cover setup. Complete Sections1--5 retain voltage covers/divisors, inverse-limit Iwasawa module and augmentation/pseudo-null comparison. The rank-one correction and later control/examples are unselected. Original dsfont/stmaryrd source imports remain archived. Actual active mathds arguments N(11), Q(12), Z(93) use the approved pinned installed LatinModernMath U+2115/U+211A/U+2124 resolver with other arguments rejected; serif/stroke/width differences from original dsrom10 are disclosed. All source body formulas are unchanged. Seven inactive original uppercase helpers remain unexpanded. Approved finite typography note: literal unsized double-square bracket controls resolve only through installed LatinModernMath U+27E6/U+27E7; the original stmary10 shape/width/vertical placement can differ. Every original bracket token and adjacent exponent/subscript is preserved, with all-use source/output glyph inventory. No unavailable package is acquired or emulated.
